nom: Clinique Moisture Surge Eye 96-Hour Hydro Filler Concentrate

avis.texte: I just had to do something for the bags under my eyes. I have to be careful with what I put on my face due my rosacea. I been using this for only one week, but it seems to be making a difference under by eyes.
This product is great ,I love it . It tightens up my eye area but it's smooth.
Terrible under makeup. Feels crumbly and dry. Returning. I'll stick to the cream, not gel.

I find this eye gel to be very sticky, even after it dries. After about 4 weeks of daily use, I really can't tell that it makes any difference. I also find that the pump gets stuck, likely due to the gel beads. When this happens, too much product is dispensed and wasted. I wouldn't buy this again. For reference: 44 yo, fair sensitive skin

This product performs exceptionally well on my middle-aged (58 years old) skin. It firms, as promised, and continues to do so even after applying another moisturizer on top of it. It says it's for eyes, but I also use it on my face and neck. It feels great under my other non-firming moisturizer and make-up, and continues to firm without too much tightness. Other filler products on the market are simply cosmetic, but I truly love that this one is actually good for your skin. Please keep making this product!
I have other moisture surge products which are excellent. This product is HORRIBLE! It never soaks in, just stays on the surface and removes a gross, sticky mess. Wholey regret wasting the money.
Just started using. A little tingly after few minutes so working . I does make my crepe-y above the eye skin look better. Adds moisture so not so dry. That's where I've been using it .

I have used other eye creams before and did not notice a difference. I had a sample of this and gave it a try. I have had a line under one of my eyes for years that I could not get rid of and after using this consistently the lines are almost gone. I also notice my eyes are much less puffy when I use this. I don't love the packaging, I feel like it's going to break, but other than that I love this stuff.

I used this product when it first came out and it has definitely changed, now I think it's better. I use a little less than half a pump. I then wait for it to soak in a few seconds, probably 20, then I layer the smart eye cream over it. So far I'm liking the results. My eyes look much more hydrated And much less saggy.
Great product. It's not sticky or gooey and absorbs quickly. Makes the eyes feel great!

avis.titre: Refreshing and hydrating — perfect for tired eyes
avis.texte: This eye gel has been a game-changer for me. It feels cool and soothing the moment I apply it, and I love the lightweight, water-gel texture. It hydrates the under-eye area without feeling heavy or greasy, and I've noticed less puffiness and dryness since I started using it. It also works great under concealer. A little goes a long way, so one bottle lasts a long time. Definitely recommend for anyone dealing with dryness or fine lines around the eyes.
The bottle breaks before I can use the product for more then a week. And they will not return the product.
It is so sticky! It makes underneath my eyes greasy. I would not recommend purchasing.
the other one for face better than this i didn't see any big deal to buy it so dispointed not again

The product itself is fine. It's cooling and somewhat hydrating. That being said, the pump is a huge pain. It's inconsistent when you depress it, sometimes nothing comes out, sometimes an entire pump's worth pf product. For the price and the amount of product, it's not worth it in my opinion. I'll use it until it's out but wont buy again.
I love this gel! It applies easily and smoothly and makes my eyes feel so much better, especially in the morning!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again.
avis.texte: I feel this product really works wonders for its intended use.
enjoy using this as a makeup prep step. cooling and moisturizing. also great at night as a hydrating mask.
I have very sensitive skin around my eyes, I love ❤️ this 57 and this works great!!!

avis.titre: Addicted - I have used it on my whole face for a year
avis.texte: I received a sample tube, and did not read the labeling. I used a small amount on moist skin as a facial moisturizer. It made my skin look amazing, and it was only when I ran out and decided to buy a full size that I read the label and realized it was an eye gel. I have used just a small amount on moist skin for a full year now, and my skin looks and feels like smooth glass. No bumps, no clogged pores, no blackheads and my formerly dull skin glows like it did ten years ago. Half the time I don't even use foundation any more - just this product. I have sensitive skin and have tried many solutions over the years, but this simple product has excelled. Clinique has had many great products over the years that have been discontinued, and I am BEGGING that they keep this one around forever!

I don't know why this product doesn't have more 5 star reviews. I love it. Like most face products, it took me about a week of using it to really see results. It really hydrates around my eyes so much better than any other product I've found and it works well to layer on top of. I also have super sensitive skin and this doesn't irritate at all. I have quickly become dependent on this product in my skincare routine.

I have been using this for a while now, used about half of it. It adds a small amount of moisture that goes away after an hour or two. It is also very sticky on the skin for an hour. The pump gets clogged too easy with the small pilled droplets in it. Nothing will come out, so have to pump it multiple times then way too much comes out and it's wasted because you cannot put any back. Very disappointing as this is too expensive for the terrible packaging. Would be better in a squeeze tube or something you can put it back into if you get too much out.
It's too sticky and doesn't spread well. I woke up the next morning with red spots on lower lids. I like Clinique a lot but not all products like my skin. Read ingredients and reviews carefully.
A slight hydration of the eye area but definetely not what the rep said I would get. Disappointed.
This product has made the Lil veins underneath my eyes diminish over time. My eyes don't look as puffy as I tap this product on & let it do it's wonders.

I've been using this eye gel for 4 months now, it really helps with fine lines/wrinkles and tired eyes as well, my only complaint is the gel beads sometimes get stuck but other than that excellent product!

avis.titre: Not worth the money, and I generally love Clinique
avis.texte: I am not really sure how this product is doing but I do know they need to think about repackaging it. The little pearls can not even come out the opening and get stuck causing the product to build up. Then it comes out in a glob which gets wasted. Clinique you can do better.
This did nothing. I see no difference. I've used morning and night consistently for the last 2 weeks. No difference.

I have used this product consistently for about 2 months. I noticed a difference in the plumpness around my eyes that I didn't have before. Love the results. My only complaint is that I have a short burning sensation after using it. Not sure what causes it.

avis.titre: I noticed a difference right away
avis.texte: Ashley in Clinique at the Commack, NY store recommended this to me and I love it. I noticed a difference right away.

avis.titre: Love the product, the packaging is a pain.
avis.texte: If I don't use eye cream in the winter, I get eczema around my eyes. This product does an excellent job at keeping the skin around my eyes hydrated, protected, and just looking better overall. If I skip a day or two I really notice. The only drawback is that the packaging is a real pain to deal with. The dispenser does not want to dispense, and when it does, random amounts of product come out. I'm on my 4th or 5th tube and they are all the same way (this tells you how good the product is, that I've stuck with it for this long). I store the tube upside down and it works well most of the time. I might try some other products soon because I'm so tired of struggling with the dispenser.
My skin was dry lately and after I applied it, it started to glowing

avis.titre: Burning and irritating to sensitive skin around eyes.
avis.texte: I will be returning this product as it has caused me discomfort. I believe that Ulta stands behind its products. And I appreciate that!
this eye serum is must have product ! it is super hydrating and has a great soft formula !

I needed more result than virtually no change for the money I spent buying this. It is sticky, assuming because of the aloe. Dries on my skin just like $3 100% aloe gel for sunburns does, maybe stickier. I've used a handful of times and have still not gotten one of the bubbles out of the pump to use on my skin. I will stick with the All About Eyes cream for puffiness and moisture. This stuff is a bust (but not literally, because the spheres won't come out)!

Every time I use this eye gel it is an instant...Ah-h-h!!! The description of this product as "refreshing" is an understatement. Also, I find that this gel is fantastic used under concealer…Especially if you have oily eyelids, have ever used an oilier-type eye cream and experienced "melted" eye makeup. However, since Moisture Surge Eye is a gel, you do have to allow the product to soak into the skin before applying a concealer. And remember to never rub under the eyes while applying the concealer. Always apply using a gentle patting and rolling motion with the pad of the ring finger or a fine-grain makeup sponge. I really feel you will enjoy using Moisture Surge Eye as an addition and part of your skincare regimen.

avis.titre: Hydrating without weight and greasy feel
avis.texte: This product is hydrating and plumping with no greasy heavy feel. Very comfortable. Feels like my own skin.

avis.titre: Better than average, but not as good as MAC
avis.texte: Not a bad product at all. I am partial to the MAC line, but I would recommend this to a friend, especially as an alternative if they didn't care for MAC
After a day in the hot sun, it dried out my eyes, they looked aweful. After my first use I immediately seen a difference. I'm fixing to order my 2nd one.

avis.titre: It made my eyes swell up and look red
avis.texte: Bought this product thinking it would be good however it made both of my eyes swell up and now my skin looks dry and starting to crack around my eyes.

I am on my second container of the moisture surge 96 hour eye product. Very happy with the results. Do not find this "tacky" at all. Soaks into the skin without residue. Some people may find that they are allergic to the "natural" ingredients but this has nothing to do with the product itself. If you find you're allergic to it, discontinue it. I will continue to purchase this product as it does work for me.

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this again!
avis.texte: Purchased this as part of a moisturizer grouping (Clinique 100 hour moisturizer), and I love the way it feels around my eyes! I do think massaging it in also helps with reducing any "bags" or fine lines - and I do notice a bit of plumping! I use it at least once a day (may increase that to 2x per day), since I've noticed my eyes look better for most of the day.

avis.titre: This is my second bottle and have been pleased.
avis.texte: I have dry eyes so they irritate easily with more emollient eye creams. Because they are so dry and I live in a drier climate I reapply during the day. Found it is best to apply a little right before applying concealer and just as it absorbs in, apply the concealer so it spreads easier. It can get a little tacky when dry, so test to see if bothers your eyes if applied to the lids. I prefer the lids at night. Some people find their make up stays on better with it on the lids. I have been pleased with this product and have bought a second one. And for dry skin highly recommend Clinique Moisture Surge Intense 72H lipid-replenishing hydrator!
This is my go to eye gel - can put it all around the eye and it does not cause milia- it's light weight, is not sticky and keeps the eye area from appearing crepey

avis.titre: Seems to be irritating my skin
avis.texte: I bought this without looking into it first because I trusted that it was a Clinique product and I was very happy with their moisture surge before. I just applied it for the first time and the skin under my eyes is still burning after one hour. I hope it will not cause a worth allergic reaction.

I got a sample with purchase and loved using it so I ordered the full bottle. Unfortunately, it caused the skin under my eyes to swell up each time I used the full size and it was a little painful. I had to send it back. I don't understand why the sample didn't cause those issued but the bottle did.
This eye gel got rid of my eyebags in less than TWO weeks after having the worst, dark eyebags so i really recommend if you want to get rid of them.
I had lots of puffiness under my eye , and i've been using this literally for a couple of days and it went away !

avis.titre: not what I thought coming from this brand
avis.texte: once this dries and I apply my foundation, it pills. I've even tried 2 other brand foundations thinking that was the problem.
I was looking for something moisturizing and tightening and this delivered. I can tell a big difference when I use it.

avis.titre: My eyelids have been burning for 24 hours after using once
avis.texte: I used this product once and have had burning eyelids for 24 hours now. Also dries very wet looking and sticky. I have been using Clinique products for years and have been happy , but not with this one.
Left my under eye skin feeling very sticky/tacky. Did not like.

I absolutely love this product and it's now a staple in my skincare. It provides hydration and has visibly reduced fine lines I was self conscious about prior to using. A little goes a long way & make sure to pop the beads before applying. The consistency is silky once dry but as other users have mentioned, slightly sticky when applying. However, that stopped being an issue after a few days. I pair it with Clinique hydro gel moisturizer & they work together nicely.

Just recently I have started getting intense dry patches around my eyes, Ive tried several brands and nothing seemed to be working. Finally decided to splurge and give this a try and I'm so glad i did! Feels like my skin is actually drinking this up when I apply it! No greasy residue and I don't need to reapply until I wash my face. Sensitive skin friendly as well! Love ❤️
I am 76 years old and this helps tighten under my eyes and my eye lids, so my eye shadow goes on without creasing.

I brought this product on the recommendation of the salesman, my under eye was very irritated basically burnt. Once I started using this product immediately I noticed a difference and is working thankfully. I am so glad I purchased it.🙏🏽
Best product ever created ! I literally can't go to bed without using this product . I told my friend if I pass bury me w this product 🤦🏽‍♀️💯🤷🏽‍♀️. I seriously love it beyond

I went into Ulta dealing with very RED, itchy, burning skin around my eyes. I don't know what caused it, but this product instantly began to relieve my issues WITHOUT burning my skin. I will use this product forever from now on!

Gave me red painful bumps under my eyes. I thought I was maybe developing a stye but styes don't form in that part of the eye. Thought it was a pimple and continued to use it and then developed the bumps on my other eye as well. Stopped using immediately and threw it away! Hope people read reviews before purchasing and not make the same mistake I did.

I'm very disappointed in this product as I love the other moisture products. The pump on this didn't work correctly. None of the beads were being dispersed at all. Only gel. I kept using it in hopes I just had to pump it more to get them out. The gel doesn't do anything but make my eye area sticky and it's definitely not good for under any kind of makeup as it just makes everything pill up and rub off. I finally got the tube apart because I wasn't about to waste the product I spent money on and even now the beads don't really break open. Just all around terrible product that I definitely would not recommend. Fix your packaging, Clinique.

The texture of the eye cream is very moist, and it feels like water when it is spread, and it is basically not very sticky Greasy feeling, it is already very good to have smoke-coolamine ingredients to do this, very suitable for summer, but I also use it in winter, because this is almost the most useful eye cream for fine lines on the surface of my eyes, it is very suitable for the age of 20+, there is not much anti-aging need for eyes, and it has a tangible improvement effect. I also wear my upper eyelid when applying it to avoid eyeshadow card powder. Overall, this eye cream is really good, super super like it~

I got just a sample of this product and it's definitely moisturizing but I found it a bit sticky and too shiny on my face. Also when tried to put tone it got all messed up. So I use it for night time only and it works this way well.
I love this eye serum I use it under another eye cream. Moisturizes dry eyes quickly as long as your consistent. Feels refreshing and cool.

I was impressed how long this container lasted me. I like best to use around my eyes for pumping hydration. It is spendy so I have been trying others. But my skin is missing this product. Nothing as good so far

I am always on the hunt for a good eye cream but this unfortunately isn't it. I make every effort to buy cruelty-free but was gifted a tube of this eye cream. So Clinique is not cruelty-free. My second point of issue is cost. If this eye cream was super hydrating and long-lasting, cost wouldn't concern me but I think this is one of the worst eye creams I've tried all year and at the highest price point at that. I personally don't like the bursting beads in beauty products but the beads aside, the formula of this is thin, slippery, and doesn't feel like it absorbs well. I tried with and without product under this eye gel but neither approach seems to help it absorb. I've tried water gels that absorb into the skin well and hold moisture all day but didn't have the same experience with this product. If you like a thin eye gel, this might be a good fit, but if you're a cream hydrator fan, keep looking!
Very nice hydrating moisture but a bit sticky if if you put too much
So far great, am on my 3rd bottle and waiting to get more. A little sticky if you put too much. Very hydrating.

avis.titre: BEST eye gel for EXTRA dry skin!!
avis.texte: Once I started using this, my under-eye skin is plump and ALIVE. Almost like I drank 5 gallons of water a day for a week straight!!
it wasn't very hydrating and was kind of clumpy. the pump started messing up halfway through the bottle.
It goes on so smooth and really made my under eye so smooth and supple. I will continue using this

I'm 64. I love using this product as an eye mask. Some of the reviews say that it feels tacky. Yes, if you use too much. The directions say to use a pea size. That's way too much and will leave that tacky feel. I found that half of a pea size works perfect for me. But most importantly, I see that my under eye area is smooth.

I love Clinique products, but am so disappointed in this. It goes on very sticky and doesn't absorb. It also did not work. The pump didn't work well and when it was about 1/4 full, the pump stopped working all together.

I'm not sure why this doesn't get better reviews - it makes a huge difference for me! I noticed that my under eyes were more hydrated and the fine lines were less visible after using for just a few days, and then noticed a big difference when I ran out. I apply a small amount to my under eye and eyelid area and let it dry. If you use more than a small amount it can get a little sticky, which doesn't bother me but other people may not like. I haven't had any issues applying concealer or eyeshadows on top of it - it doesn't ball up or anything. If you have sensitive skin and are looking for moisture, i highly recommend this!

The micro beads in this product caused peri-orifice dermatitis around both of my eyes. I've had this pernicious skin infection for 6 months now. I've been using a prescribed topical immunosuppressant and one topical antibiotic for about five months and I've had little resolution so far. Moisturizing your eye lids with a product like this is gambling with your long term skin health. I do not recommend it.

I've been searching for a product like this for decades. It eliminates my under eye puffiness like it's nothing. Unike many other "instant change" products this one did not pill under makeup. My search is over I'm so happy.
I was very disappointed in this product. I felt that it was sticky and didn't absorb into my skin very well. And it's not that cheap. It's my least favorite product of Clinique's.

I absolutely love this product. Personally, I ONLY use it at night before bed because it is a little tacky/sticky so I use it as more of a overnight mask and I ONLY use a pea size amount between both eyes. I understand that not one product is good for everyone but it's definitely worth the try.
good: super hydrated, a little goes a long way & best at night bad: tacky feeling, with a little bit under my eyes it created clogged pores under my eyes
Love this stuff!!! It doesn't aggravate my rosacea at all, which is saying a lot. Makes my eyes look brighter and more awake. It de-puffs my eyes a TON! Can't say enough good stuff about it.
I always se before applying makeup for a dewy look, my under eyes look great but product is a little sticky. Massage in and let it completely dry before applying anything else for the best look

I don't think this is a bad product, I just don't think it's a game changer. Especially for the price. I did get a deal on it which is why I tried it, given some of the raving reviews - …I just don't think for me it will be a staple. It does absorb quickly but I just don't feel any additional hydration. Bottom line you just might have to try this one for yourself.

Im really glad I gave the hydro filler a go. I didn't have the same issue of sticky residue or beads not breaking but found it to be a nice light weight serum to use before foundation without fearing my makeup will slide from the area.
I got this and was excited but when I used it, my skin felt very drawn, dry. I got a two pack special and now don't even like it.

I have very dry undereyes. It's always a challenge to find a great eye cream that can stand up to the job. This deeply moisturizing eye serum is a game-changer! I use it as a serum and apply it first on the whole eye area, let it sink-in for a little while & follow it with a good eye cream. Wonderful moisturization, line-plumping & smoothing! Also, it is very cooling & soothing to the entire eye area. It doesn't get better than this!

Greatest eye treatment I've come across. Brightens my eyes & decreases dark circles. Problem is the pump. At least the last 8 or so treatments are wasted in end of pump. Otherwise I highly recommend. Im olive skinned & almost 50.

avis.titre: Disappointed, especially for a Clinique product
avis.texte: So far, not really happy...been using for a week, not hydrated at all, skin under my eyes is breaking out - wish I could return
The pump is bad, have to pump several times to get product and after a while it just stopped working, cannot get the product. It is very frustrating.

I really like this product. It's very hydrating. Yes it's a bit tacky at first but it dries fine. You can avoid a bit of the tackiness if you dab it on quickly vs handling it too much. Product would be even better if the little capsules actually came out with every pump. 90% of the time none come out, they seem to clog in the pump. 10% of the time they all come out at once. Dumb. You aren't getting the benefit of the capsules majority of the time. A tube seems like it would function better.
This stuff made my wrinkles way more visible, felt like plastic on my eyes and was just not worth it to me. Returned not happy.
Recently just started using this, and dang my under eye never looked so good. No more creasing with this added to makeup routine!

I've been using this for 2 yrs and it's my holy grail. It plumps my fine lines and wrinkles which makes for a crease-free concealer application. You only need a small pump for both eyes; warm up between your fingers and tap into damp skin. You must let it dry for at least a few minutes before applying concealer or it may pill. Do it right, and your concealer will look flawless!

I love this eye concentrate! I have sensitive eyes and have no reaction to this. It's so smoothing and hydrating. It is a little sticky but because of that it makes the most amazing concealer base. I've never had my under eye concealer look so good! The stickiness goes away though after awhile if you're not putting concealer on. All in all, it's my favorite eye product!
Use this morning and evening - dab all around the eyes - very moisturizing gel that doesn't clog pores and can be layered under a cream

I rarely write reviews but was so pleased with this that I had to share. I've been dealing with dry, flaky skin around my eyes including my eyelids. I am sensitive to many eye products. While they don't irritate initially, I wake up the next day with my eyes feeling puffy, dry, or gritty. I had none of these issues with Clinique Moisture Surge. The skin around my eyes was noticeably less dry after just the first use. Also, just a little bit of moisturizer is needed and it hasn't been necessary to apply every day so I feel like one bottle will last quite a while.
this concentrate is must have product ! i am totally in love with it, it moistures my skin and makes it glowy!
Under eyes...concealer seems to go on more evenly when using this as base

This is one Clinique product I simply can't live without! It goes on a little sticky, but as it dries (and you need to let it dry) it settles into any fine lines you might have around your eyes, so that when you apply undereye concealer, IT doesn't settle into the lines! My eyes actually appear younger and brighter.

I didn't think I was going to like this product, because it felt very sticky after application. I decided to try letting it dry completely, before applying any make up. It took about an hour to absorb and dry completely, but after that…the stickiness was gone…and my eye make up application was smooth. If you don't have an hour to wait, to let this absorb, I would use it only at night time.

I love this product! A little goes a long way. I also have extremely sensitive skin. Everything makes me break out or peal with the exception of a few certain products and this moisture surge. I put it under the eye and a tad on the eye lid/outer corner. No burning

I had such a severe reaction to this product that, with little improvement after 2 days I had to go to the doctor and start taking steroids and antihistamines. I'm hoping my skin returns to normal and will no longer be a faithful Clinique customer.
this is the only eye serum I use! my under eyes have never been more hydrated

I got this product as a sample and it made my eyelids dry, rough, and red. I normally use the Kiehls avocado eye cream or the photo contour from yonka Paris for my eyes and I have never had a problem with either of those. This one looks cool because of the beads in it but it just didn't work for me.

I initially got this as a sample and had to run out and buy more! I use this morning and night and it really hydrates my eyes. It also has done a wonderful job of helping me keep my brittle eyelashes softer, with less loss. Yes, it's a little sticky, but that just tells me it's working. I put my eye shadow right over it and have no problems.

avis.titre: Dispenser needs a re-do - it's messing up a great product!
avis.texte: I've used half of this and have yet to see a little red dot capsule in the gel mix after pumping. Initially I pumped out a ton of it....almost a quarter of it just looking for the little fortified micro dots. I feel like they all must be trapped in the pump or something. When I first tried this as a sample...the dots came out of the simple tube easily and you would crush with your fingers and they'd be mixed in and applied. The results were astounding. However this dispenser completely defeats the whole purpose of this product.

This was bought on a whim as I was getting stocking stuffers and Christmas gifts at Ulta. A lady at ulta said this product would be great. I was skeptical as I've used many products and even Botox to correct the bags and tired eye look. Used on December 31st and on New Years , my eyes and face Look/looked so much better. I can't believe it actually works as I've bought product that costs over $100 that didn't do anything, as for the comments that say it's glue like, are right but it goes away shortly! I love it and the price is to cheap. Then you Clinique !
Love this stuff! I have super sensitive skin around my eyes, which can cause swelling and discomfort. It soothes my skin and makes my undereye area look refreshed.
